_comment: A placeholder, not a baseline. It fails on purpose, and it will go on
failing until a person replaces it with a run of ./plumbline-gate.sh they
have read and are willing to be held to.
It is here rather than absent because absent is the more dangerous state:
a gate with no baseline compares nothing, so a score can decay from 0.99
to 0.36 and stay green the whole way down. A floor is a minimum; a
Replace this whole file with the audit JSON the gate writes. Do not edit
the numbers in a real one to make a red gate green: that is the one
manoeuvre the interlock exists to make impossible, and it is why the
baseline is committed and reviewed like any other diff.
